source.label: FY2025 Form 20-F, Item 7.A, Issued share capital, shareholdings and share prices
source.quote: At 31 December 2025, the Company had 61,133 registered holders of 1,550,907,927 Ordinary Shares.

notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK); NBIM also holds AstraZeneca corporate bonds in a separate row, not counted. CalPERS: the information table of its Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 lists no AstraZeneca shares (searched by issuer name), even though the Ordinary Shares have been listed directly on the NYSE since February 2, 2026. Holders of record: registered holders of Ordinary Shares only. The same section separately lists 174,889 holders of Ordinary Shares held under the Euroclear Services Agreement (9.9% of issued share capital) and 4,598 registered holders of ADSs (18.3%); these are not added.
